1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Describe why the audit failed.
3. Describe what actions need to be taken to rectify the issues.
4. Outline a timeline for completing these actions.
5. Assign responsibility to specific individuals for completing each action item.
6. Propose a follow-up audit.
7. Keep a copy of the document.
